name: CodeRabbit
tagline: An AI code-review agent, not a code-writing one — reviews every pull request automatically across GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket and Azure DevOps, with a genuine free tier for unlimited repos.
verdict: CodeRabbit occupies a genuinely different slot in this category than any other listing: it reviews pull requests and commits automatically rather than writing code from a prompt, so it complements a coding agent instead of competing with it. The free tier is real (unlimited repos for PR summaries and IDE/CLI review, not just a capped trial), the funding and NVIDIA reference customer are independently corroborated, and its four-host coverage (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps) is broader than most single-purpose review tools. The real costs show up going deeper: API access and self-hosting are Enterprise-only, and per-seat paid pricing stacks on top of whatever already generates the code being reviewed.
